series.title: I Know I Love You [Hindi]
series.description: Xu Nuo, a florist, meets a veterinary doctor, Zhao Jin, serendipitously, when both are at a crossroads in their lives and decide to stay platonic friends. They however struggle to deny how they fill the missing parts of each other's lives.

series.title: I Do, I Do
series.description: Hwang Ji An is the top shoe designer in a major shoe company. She is in her 30s, successful and single. One night, she makes a horrible mistake and sleeps with Park Tae Gang, a good-looking new employee in her company, and she finds out she is pregnant. Ji An's hard-earned career and her stylish lifestyle threatens to implode as a result of her one-night-stand mistake. Will Ji An be forced to give up everything and live with the consequences of her mistake?

series.description: Ray J is back for another season of For the Love of Ray J. Last season he picked the best girl in the house, but unfortunately it wasn't the best girl for him. Ray wants to give love a second chance, and this time he wants to find the right girl for him.

series.title: Love J Action
series.description: Love is not just blind, it chooses to be blind. Jackson gets the girl of his dreams against all odds, but when she betrays him, his obsession takes on a form so Machiavellian, even he can not predict how far he'll go.

series.title: P.J.
series.description: Follows law enforcement agents in the 10th and 11th arrondissements of Paris as they deal with crime and their personal lives.

series.title: J-Trip Plan

series.title: Alfred J. Kwak
series.description: After a horrific car accident takes the lives of his parents and siblings, a young duckling is raised by his considerate uncle to be good and responsible; meanwhile, his schoolmate Dolf slowly becomes seduced by fascism.

series.description: Five-year-old Little J and nine-year-old Big Cuz are a couple of indigenous Australian kids living with their Nanna and old dog. All their friends are nearby, and school is just a stroll away along a bush track.

series.title: Sammy J
series.description: Biting, bite-sized comedy as Sammy J rips into the political machinations of Canberra and beyond. With an insatiable appetite for politics, Sammy blends comedy and song where he can harass and heckle the politics of the day.

series.title: Saber Marionette J Again
series.description: The reformed marionettes Tiger, Luchs, and Panther are sent to stay with Otaru to learn more about being human. A new mysterious marionette named Marine also appears.

series.title: Jenius
series.description: Even gods and devils go to school.

series.title: Saber Marionette J [English]
series.description: The male-only planet of Terra II is populated by clones of the six men who were marooned there 300 years before. The only females are robots called "marionettes," who serve as workers and soldiers. Japoness marionettes Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry are different from most others, because each possesses a special circuit that gives them human emotions. One by one, they are accidentally awakened by young Mamiya Otaru and take up residence with him. As a result, Otaru's uneventful life becomes just a tad more interesting. At the same time, conflict between Japoness and the city-state of Gartland is escalating. Is it because Faust, the leader of Gartland, lusts for world domination, or is it something else his heart longs for... something with a connection to Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry?

series.title: Neighborhood Witch J
series.description: A star in the world of internet content creation, Seo Je Yi (Park Ji Yeon) has made quite a name for herself as a beauty expert. A smooth talker who isn't afraid to tell it like it is, Je Yi has amassed an impressive following since the start of her career and the numbers just keep rising. With so many dedicated followers, companies are beginning to take notice of Je Yi, including Lee Woo Bin (Lee Tae Sun), the CEO of a cosmetics start-up company whose products Je Yi has acknowledged on more than one occasion. A highly intelligent man, Lee Woo Bin knows what it takes to run a company well but when it comes to social interaction, he has absolutely no idea what he's doing. Encouraged by Je Yi's glowing reviews of his products, Woo Bin has tried, on more than one occasion, to get better acquainted with the rising star, but every attempt he has made so far has failed miserably. Meanwhile, Lee Tae Kyung (Jang Eui Soo), the director of MCN, a company specializing in managing content creators, has taken a sudden interest in Je Yi and he's determined to win her over. With so many roads now opening before her, Je Yi must decide which path will lead to both her success and happiness. But which path should she choose when her head tells her to go one way and her heart tells her to go another? The first selection for the 2020 pilot division of the Broadcasting Content Production Support Project, "Next Door Witch J" is a 2021 Viki Original romantic drama directed by Yoon Ji Hoon.

series.title: Brandee J Talk Show
series.description: San Diego Native Brandee Joyner ''pka" Brandee J is changing how the world views real women, their bodies, and interests with a down to earth approach to life, culture, celebrities, and total body positivity.

series.title: B.J. and the Bear
series.description: A trucker and his pet chimpanzee travel the highways of America, getting into various adventures and misadventures along the way.

series.title: Donald J. Trump Presents: The Ultimate Merger
series.description: Through a series of challenges, both relationship- and business-driven, Omarosa attempts to choose a mate from a stable of 12 bachelors.

series.title: PB&J Otter S3
series.description: Peanut, Jelly, and Baby Butter are three young otters who live on Lake Hoohaw with their family and friends.

series.title: Saber Marionette J
series.description: The male-only planet of Terra II is populated by clones of the six men who were marooned there 300 years before. The only females are robots called "marionettes," who serve as workers and soldiers. Japoness marionettes Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry are different from most others, because each possesses a special circuit that gives them human emotions. One by one, they are accidentally awakened by young Mamiya Otaru and take up residence with him. As a result, Otaru's uneventful life becomes just a tad more interesting. At the same time, conflict between Japoness and the city-state of Gartland is escalating. Is it because Faust, the leader of Gartland, lusts for world domination, or is it something else his heart longs for... something with a connection to Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry?

series.title: Channel K
series.description: Half-hour series comprised of shorter segments, all lampooning TV programming, all intentionally in bad taste. Included "Bachelor Pad," where love guru Chad Randolph offered tips to single dudes on how to score chicks while on a budget; "Bikini Beat," where police badges come on skimpy bathing suits; "The Handy Dan Show," where an incompetent do-it-your-self expert showed the TV audience why to never do it yourself; "Life Styles of the Poor and Unkbown," a glamorous look at the not-so-glamorous lives of the under-privileged; "Too Hip," about a pair of Simease twins joined at the hip, one neat, one sloppy, who serve as police detectives; "6 and 1/2 Minutes," an investigative news magazine uncovering stories not big enough for prime time; and "Gomer Hiel, N.A.Z.I.," following the madcap adventures of an inept soldier in the World War II German army, among others.

series.description: "K-Town" is a new, dynamic unscripted reality show that explores the lives of incredibly colorful Asian Americans who reside in the heart of Koreatown, Los Angeles. series.title: K.O. Beast [English]
series.description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

series.title: Puteshestvie k tsentru dushi
series.description: Saga about the lives of two young women, Rita and Vera, who became closest friends at a crucial historical moment of USSR's collapse. The story covers twenty years of their life. Because of the love for the same man, Maksim, Rita and Vera turn from the best friends into deadly enemies, dangerous for each other. Bitterly envious of Rita, insidious Vera is dreaming to get her hands not only on Rita's love, but also on her money and her life. At the same time, Rita wishes to start her life from scratch. And one day fate gives each of them a unique chance: to start their life anew. However, old grievances and sins do not allow Vera to forget about the past and stop hating her more successful and pure friend Rita.

series.title: Second Husband
series.description: Bong Seon Hwa overcomes childhood adversity through resilience, rising in her family's confectionery business. Her lifelong bond with Moon Sang Hyuk faces tragedy when desire costs her family. She vows revenge after an unjust loss.

series.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas [Hindi]
series.description: "Four Hands" is a piano term that refers to a technique where two people play a single piano together. The drama will depict the friendship, love, rivalry, and growth of youths who meet at an arts high school, following their journey from adolescence to adulthood as professional pianists. Set in an arts high school, the series follows Kang Bi-o, Chae Jeong-yo, and Jae-in as they grow from their school days into adulthood.

series.description: Tha L. Spot Show is a daytime talk show aired on Brooklyn Free Speech that reaches the homes of over 550,000 Spectrum, Optimum, RCN and Verizon Fios users throughout Brooklyn and everyone throughout the world has access by streaming online. The show features entertainers, business owners, and experts in various fields during the panel discussion, in-the-field, and one-on-one interview segments. Our show demographic is 66% women and 33% men who are between the ages of 18 years old and 49 years old. Tha L. Spot Show's executive producer, Jessica Lanice Chalmers, also known as, Empress Lanice has designed the show to have different hosts every other season. It allows newcomers who want to become a television host an opportunity to become one and gain the experience. The show is co-produced by Camille J. Cruz who has been a part of the show since its inception. Season 1 was hosted by Empress Lanice and Camille Jay.

series.description: Another story of a big family whose life is full of problems and unexpected changes. Barbara and Lucjan are about 60-years-old. They have three daughters and one son. series.title: Love es M The Animation
series.description: A kind and reliable older sister, Mizushiro Ayaka. A younger childhood friend and now my girlfriend, Tsurutani Ayaka. While I’m happily getting along with the two, I wasn’t satisfied. That is because I have a hobby that I must keep hidden. I want to do S&M. I secretly buy tools for my personal use – stare at it, touch it. And then one day as I was expelling myself of my urges, I noticed that someone had entered my room and saw the secret. Let’s try setting a trap… I turn to see who discovered my secret. And so, our abnormal relationship began. Based on the erotic game by Noesis.

series.title: Beat n Path
series.description: This docu-series follows Lupe Fiasco, a Grammy award winning rapper from Chicago, as he drops everything to embark on a cross-cultural journey across China to live out his other passion - martial arts. Dubbed the "King of Lyrical Trickiness," Lupe applies his skill for lyrical flow to the movements of kung fu, joining the world's greatest martial arts masters as they teach Lupe their secrets. Lupe also takes the opportunity to explore China's hip hop scene and record his next hit, Air China, a song inspired by his journey and experience.

series.title: Class N Session
series.description: Casting "Class N Session," a new series. Synopsis: Meet Kaitlyn Johnson (Jassy Marie), an intelligent, teenage African American sophomore girl with a quick sarcastic wit to match, which fits her future aspiration of becoming a criminal lawyer, which stems from watching marathon episodes of "Law and Order" on cable with her mother. Kaitlyn's best friend since pre-K is Vanessa Hardison (Alexis Dees), who's also an intelligent African American sophomore girl who decided her own future aspiration of becoming a celebrity lawyer after watching old footage of Johnny Cochran's performance in the O. J. Simpson trial. She also has a similar sarcastic quick wit. For years, these girls used the same facial expression to communicate with each other when someone said something idiotic. Their favorite facial expression is named "The Garfield Look," which matches the bored facial expression of Garfield the Cat. Both young ladies attend Ladera Heights High School, along with their new friends, Lisa Kim (their eccentric but very smart friend), Caleb Stevens and Louis Taylor (two of the brightest class clowns you ever want to meet; think Romeo and Bullethead from "The Steve Harvey Show," with intelligence), and Cissy Bailey (their sassy Caucasian friend who was raised in the hood). This prestigious secondary school is run by Principal Bryant, a very thorough, no-nonsense principal who's fair but firm and also has an annoying tendency to pop up unannounced on her students anywhere. Principal Bryant doesn't tolerate disruptive students who waste their time in high school; she's especially strict on rules about the students not sassing their parents. Every high school student has a favorite teacher; Mr. Reevis is that favorite teacher, who uses wit to teach his U.S. Government class. With Kaitlyn and Vanessa's aspirations of becoming a criminal lawyer and celebrity lawyer, can they survive through all the trials and tribulations high school has in store for them? Watch "Class N Session" to find out.

series.title: Tig N' Seek S1-S4
series.description: 8-year-old Tiggy and his gadget-building cat, Gweeseek, search for the lost items of Wee Gee City. The duo humorously navigates day-to-day dilemmas at the Department of Lost and Found.

series.title: Rock 'n' Road
series.description: Lin, who used to be a child star and is now a singer, meets Zhou, a music genius, dramatically changing not only life with his girlfriend Yang, but also his best friend Xu. Band member Wang and his girlfriend Q are relegated to the role of peacemaker between Zhou and Xu, always trying to keep their friendships tight and their aspirations for the band to be on the a-list in tact. This is the story about five young people and their band.

series.title: 'n Shrink
series.description: Dr. Jerry, a psychiatrist, starts an online counseling group for web addicts.

series.title: Survive N Chicago
series.description: Based on a true story about the struggles of Greg Jr growing up on the Southside of Chicago, dodging death more than twice, and seeking revenge on the shooter who shot his Mother 17 times over a parking space and his Father attempts to talk him out of it.

series.title: Salle n° 8
series.description: In ward 8 of a Parisian hospital, patients come and go but the staff stay. There are Anne and Serge, the medical externs, Philippe, the resident, Madeleine, a nurse, Marc, the surgeon, Mamadou, the orderly, etc., shown in their daily life.

series.title: BL!N Magazine
series.description: BLIN Magazine, a member of the DEPO media group, is an information portal for "a new rhythm of life".

series.title: Business N' Debt
series.description: Business N' Debt follows our protagonist Micah as he battles against all odds to create the number one business.

series.title: Science 'N Stuff
series.description: Mission Unstoppable Showrunner Anna Wenger interviews STEM professionals featured on the TV program, featuring science news, games, and audience participation.

series.title: Hunter n Hornet
series.description: Two wannabe pick up artists are on a quest to find their dream girl. Their biggest obstacle is themselves. They're too scared to talk to girls, so they role play pick up scenarios - on each other.

series.title: Fish 'N Chips
series.description: Fish and Chips, the animated series tells the stories of two antagonistic characters, young impressionable "Fish" and his mischievous, lifelong enemy "chips" as they tear across both land and sea in these exciting adventures that are sure to have both children and adults laughing.

series.title: Games N Roses
series.description: -Humorous channel proposing analyses that will perhaps make you realize that the conspiracists are those who set up the conspiracy and not those who denounce it.

series.title: Nyala O
series.description: Nyala

series.title: Love of the S*n
series.description: When Charger Block dies with no option for recovery, he must learn how to adapt to the never-ending afterlife with his operator and friend.

series.title: Texas Flip N' Move
series.description: House flippers purchase run down, almost condemned frame houses that have been set for demolition to make way for larger homes. They move the houses to an auction lot where they renovate the houses and sell at auction.

series.title: Tic Tak N' Toe
series.description: The outrageous adventures of a flea named Tic, and a tick named Tac that live on the second toe of a dog's paw.

series.title: Lance N' Masques [English]
series.description: Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendant of the "Knights of the World." With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

series.title: Big N Funky Present
series.description: Ever wonder what would happen if the cast of Wrestling With Ghosts were turned into paper dolls and hosted a monster movie TV Show? Neither did we, but here it is.

series.title: Rock N' Roll Fantasy Camp
series.description: Hosted by Carrie Keagan, Rock n' Roll Fantasy Camp is an hour-long, weekly docu-series, that lets viewers watch as 15 musicians from a variety of backgrounds and cities go through the transformative process of becoming "Rock Stars."

series.title: LOL with The N
series.description: Each episode of "LOL with The N" provides a behind-the-scenes look at four different comedy acts at the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

series.title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers
series.description: Chip and Dale are chipmunks that start a detective agency, Rescue Rangers, with their friends. The gang deals with crimes that are 'too small' for the police to manage.

series.title: Out N' Around
series.description: Host Jess Abran visits different boroughs of Montreal to tell us about the fun stuff to do in the city.

series.title: Vitamina N
series.description: Vitamina N

series.title: Lock 'n' Load
series.description: On the heels of the U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on the 2nd Amendment which reinforces every American's right to bear arms, this show is a fly on the wall at "The Shootist" gun store in Englewood, Colorado, where salesman Josh Ryan is always in full-on pitch mode - and the steady stream of customers never stops. And for every gun sold by this expert gunslinger at this family-owned store, there's a fascinating story and a fascinating buyer to tell it to him: the new parent who wants to protect his family; the teenager who's an expert hunter; the 30-something woman who feels a little more at ease with a revolver in her purse and the avid collector who simply has a fascination with guns of all kinds. There's even a shooting range in the basement to try out the merchandise before completing the sale.

series.title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
series.description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

series.title: The Great North S1-S5
series.description: The adventures of a single dad and his weird Alaskan family.

series.title: Chiquis 'n Control
series.description: Chiquis heads to New York City and confronts her shopping addiction only to return home to L.A. to face selling all her luxury goods to raise money for the salon.

series.title: Rock 'n' Wrestling
series.description: Saturday-morning cartoon series featuring the stars of the World Wrestling Federation.

series.title: Fame N Fishin'
series.description: Fishing guide Robin Rebman and singer songwriter Earl 'Peanutt' Montgomery take country music stars for fishing, conversation and singalongs along the Tennessee River.

series.title: Rise 'n Shine Og
series.description: A show about an adorably hateful British woman living in Canada, trying to make her way through the world one miserable morning at a time. Rise 'n Shine Og is a comedic web series that chronicles the life of a lovable but crude 20 something slacker Brit living in Canada. Each webisode begins with our leading lady, Og, rising out of bed to meet the day. As is the case with all of us, some of Og's days start out on the right foot and some (most) do not, but regardless of how it begins she always manages to give the day an interesting spin... or does the day manage to give her a spin? Hmmm.

series.title: Live Aid: When Rock 'n' Roll Took on the World
series.description: Interviews with musicians and political figures who became part of the Live Aid that started with Bob Geldof feeling bad at a party after a famine reportage in Ethiopia. He contacted Mide Ure the made a song, and gathered British artists.

series.title: Rock 'n Roll Kids
series.description: Love triangle between a girl from a traditional family and two members of a rock band.

series.title: Kit ^n^ Kate
series.description: Two small kitties named Kit and Kate love their toy box. As soon as they hop inside, magic starts to happen. Kids' imagination transforms their room into a blueberry island, racetrack, or medieval castle. Every time, the kitties create a whole new world with amazing discoveries, surprises, and not-so-easy-to-solve dilemmas.

series.title: Lance N' Masques
series.description: Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendant of the "Knights of the World." With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

series.description: A series of independent fictional episodes that follow the evolution of Brazilian popular music across the 20th century.

series.title: O Aprendiz
series.description: This is the Brazilian Version of the TV show The Apprentice where the contestants compete in this reality show. There are a total of 8 seasons. The 3rd Season the prize was a contract with WPP Group, the largest advertising group of the world in New York working for Wunderman NY. The 4th season of the Brazilian version of the show The Apprentice with a twist, instead an employee a partner for a company will be chosen. As a reward for winning the show they visit Anselmo Martini, winner of the Aprendiz 3 and also the Blue Sky studios.

series.title: O Access
series.description: The host travels around the world interviewing music celebrities.

series.title: Man-O
series.description: Owen, 25, suffers from the eating disorder anorexia nervosa. In 8 days, he's scheduled to enter an inpatient treatment facility where he will spend the next two months attempting to treat his disorder. This is his story.

series.title: Harry O
series.description: After being shot in the line of duty, Harry Orwell was forced to retire from the San Diego Police Department. To supplement his police pension, Harry runs a private detective agency out of his beach house.

series.title: Amanda O
series.description: Amanda O es una diva del pop admirado y blanco favorito de los paparazzi. Acusado de ser un ladrón, Amanda es asediado por los periodistas en una ceremonia de premiación. La angustiada Amanda huye y se despierta al día siguiente magullado, maltratado y en un lugar desconocido. En su viaje para recuperar su identidad, Amanda va a cambiar drásticamente y enamorarse de un salvador más inesperado.

series.title: Generation O!

series.title: O prigipas
series.description: A farmer decides to stage his death in order to avoid paying his unfair debts and scare some people into doing the right thing. When he is seen alive by his fellow villagers they think it is a miracle which the military government of the time tries to take advantage of.

series.title: Cinema Conversations with Stephen P. Jarchow
series.description: Join host Stephen P. Jarchow as he sits down for an up close and personal conversation with some of the most talented and accomplished individuals in the world of motion pictures today.

series.title: P. King Duckling
series.description: P. King Duckling is an animated comedy series that follows the adventures of a friendly but slightly hapless duck P. King and his two best friends, Wombat and Chumpkins, as they find hilarious and creative ways to overcome challenges.

series.title: P@St Forward
series.description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

series.title: P.S. I Hate You
series.description: Friends are bonded by "Love" or "Secrets"?

series.title: R
series.description: The story revolves around Franco (Mauricio Ochmann), a man who lives a miserable life, since his wife does not respect him, and his children do not pay attention to him and only see him as a hindrance. As if that were not enough, after a medical examination Franco finds out that he has terminal cancer, and decides to live his life to the fullest without caring about anything. In his rampant madness, he murders a drug trafficker in self-defense and later learns that the medical certificate stating that he had cancer turned out to be false. So now Franco must flee from justice and from the partners of the drug trafficker he murdered.

series.title: R U the Boy?
series.description: Scandocious J.r. has seen the heights of his career being appreciated for his musical talents as an openly gay rapper/singer. The only thing he hasn't been able to accomplish is finding true love. To make this distant dream a reality Scandocious J.r. enlists his closest friends to help him find Mr right. Put on your seat belts, and get ready to find out if he can find his one, and only!

series.title: Code R
series.description: The adventures of the fire, police & rescue departments of California's Channel Island.

series.title: DVD-R Hell
series.description: Brad Jones shows off his large collection of DVD bootlegs, which contain everything from self-help videos to notorious TV pilots to animated specials.

series.title: Ultraman R/B
series.description: When two brothers with clashing personalities obtain incredible powers, they focus on overcoming their differences to defend Earth as a superhero team.

series.title: R-15 S1-S15
series.description: Takuto Akutagawa has a special ability for writing porn novels. He applies to Hirameki Gakuen a high school which only accepts people with "Unique" talent. Now he must chase his dream and direct his classmates to win an interclass competition. All while trying to create the prefect harem.

series.title: Penny on M.A.R.S. S3
series.description: Following the adventures of Penny, a girl who has a big talent and a big passion: singing. Her mother is a famous singer so it probably runs in the family well anyway penny is always called by a different surname as no one knows her mother has a child so technically she's a secret baby. She decides to enroll in the most famous performing arts school, M.A.R.S. Her passion will encourage her to fight for her dreams alongside her best friend Camilla. And soon, the arrival of a boy will complicate things. You better watch this great show to get the rest of the details.

series.title: Daily T
series.description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

series.title: The Good Sh*t
series.description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

series.title: Street Fighter II: V S1-S2
series.description: Based off of the video game, on an island off the coast of Japan, Ryu, a martial artist, was given an invitation and some American money from his friend Ken Masters, telling him to come to the United States. Ryu arrives in San Francisco and Ken picks him up from the airport. Only to find out that Ken is rich and a defined martial artist himself. One night both Ryu and Ken were out scouting San Francisco for bars. Then, Ken flirts with somebody's girlfriend and gets into a fight. Ken has defeated the person. Only to find out that it was a partner of Air force pilot Guile. Ryu fights him, but was defeated easily. Ken then finds Guile and was too defeated. Ken then realizes that guile was a fighter of thew likes that Ryu and Ken has not seen before, Guile was a Street Fighter. So, both Ryu and Ken decided to set out to the world to learn the ways of the street fighter. Then, they get tangled up into a conspiracy involving a criminal organization.

series.title: Ne v svoey tarelke
series.description: Only Igor knows the truth about the alien guests. But Sergey Petrovich also senses that something is wrong in the village, so he begins an investigation. No one believes him, because the newcomers have unexpectedly quickly integrated into village life: Igor has met those who will help raise the village, Father Agafon has met someone to guide on the true path, the teacher Ira has found a kindred spirit in the optimist Roma, and the saleswoman Lyuba has found a hero in the form of the interplanetary protector Borya. While Sveta, Borya and Roma's mother, is repairing the ship, the whole family lives in human shells. But hiding the truth is becoming more difficult due to strange events around, including beavers who have begun to talk thanks to an alien substance that has fallen into the river.

series.title: Mobile Suit Victory Gundam
series.description: Uso Ewin gets himself tangled in a battle between the Yellow Jacket and guerrilla resistance League Militaire. Following his heart, Uso pilots the resistance's mobile suit and goes against the Zanscare Empire of space.

series.title: Lotto Millionaire
series.description: One day, a simple and humble family wins the lottery. In no time, a group of relatives, friends, and neighbors gathers around them, each wanting a share of the rich prize.

series.title: Dai Sentai Goggle-V
series.description: The Dark Science Empire Desdark launches its scheme for world conquest from their Destopia Castle in Germany. Dr. Hideki Hongo, founder of the Future Science Laboratory, is saved from one of their attacks by world class explorer Kenichi Akama. Using his Computer Boys and Girls, Hongo recruits five people, including Kenichi, to form the Dai Sentai Goggle-V (Goggle 5), the only force capable of stopping Desdark.

series.title: Vor v zagone
series.description: Moscow psychologist Anton is a sensitive, gentle and open person. He comes to Ust-Baikalsk to meet the family of his pregnant girlfriend and quickly realizes that his future father-in-law Mikhail Petrovich is not just a stern businessman, but a man with an anxiety disorder. Anton decides to help him, but suddenly finds out that Mikhail Petrovich is one of the leaders of a local organized crime group, who has gone so deep into disguise that even the family does not suspect anything. Then, instead of a romantic trip, there are criminal showdowns and immersion in a world where it becomes dangerous for a psychologist to be too kind. But the paradox is that it is psychological subtlety that becomes the tool without which the mafia patriarch cannot cope - neither with his anxiety, nor with his enemies, nor with his own family.

series.title: Unprincipled. Advantageous Age
series.description: Valya and Khadyakov quarreled: the general screwed up big time. And Valentina packed up her things and left Patriki for St. Petersburg. She decided to settle in the cultural capital, because her soul asks for high feelings and art, and Valentina tells Khadyakov not to approach a cannon shot. The general drowns his grief in his work, now he is always on business trips: at the factory, then in a private jet, then in a hotel, then in a Moscow office. Traveling around the country, they constantly try to get him drunk and seduce him, but he vowed not to enter into a relationship. Meanwhile, Valentina continues to study music and conquer St. Petersburg.

series.title: Dr. W
series.description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

series.title: Business Proposal
series.description: In disguise as her friend, Ha-ri shows up to a blind date to scare him away. But plans go awry when he turns out to be her CEO - and makes a proposal.

series.title: Salma w Sari
series.description: Salma and Sari is about two young Palestinians who find themselves in a situation they weren't ready for. The series is set in East Jerusalem, where life under Israeli occupation is stressful and pressure leads to aggression. Their friends and family make it difficult for them to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. Salma is only eighteen. She grew up without a father, and pressure on her mother to protect Salma from society grows. Salma has a passion for photography, and struggles to convince her mother to support her goals. She has to take matters into her own hands, to follow her dreams, whatever the cost. Sari didn't go to college and works at his family business. He's good at what he does, but that's not good enough for his family. As he reaches the age of twenty four, his family insists it's time to marry and start a family. Sari's friends have different plans for him. They are young, bored, and love cars. And you know what that means - trouble. This creative drama for social change is set in East Jerusalem and other areas in the West Bank.

series.title: Yasmine w Folla
series.description: Yasmine w Folla

series.title: Sla W Slam
series.description: After her mother's death, Karima, who works as a notary in Casablanca, returns to her hometown, Boujad, to receive her inheritance, driven by her disillusion with love. She finds herself forced to practice her mother's profession as a wedding planner, enlisting the help of her failed childhood friends.

series.title: W Series
series.description: W Series is an all-female single-seater motor racing championship. It was created in response to the lack of female drivers within the motorsport industry and thus limit the chances of progressing to the highest levels of motorsport, particularly Formula 1. The series' first season was in 2019; it featured twenty drivers contesting six races.

series.title: Khamsa W Nos
series.description: A love triangle that starts when a love story between a strong woman and a power seeking politician deteriorates because of his hunger to power and money, and she only finds comfort with his own bodyguard.

series.title: Mardi w Dahham
series.description: It follows two brothers-in-law, Mardi and Dahham, and the many problems that take place between Mardiya and her husband Dahham, while Mardi attempts to reconcile them.

series.title: Koulha W Teriqou
series.description: During the eighties in Morocco and exactly in Rabat, the well-known carpet merchant Mamoun lives an ordinary life with his large family, until the day the family finds itself amid serious difficulties and conflicts, and the lives of its members are turned upside down, so that Mamoun faces a set of challenges to save his family as the head of the family.

series.title: Rozmowy w toku
series.description: A talk-show in which people share their unusual life stories. Episodes range from less serious to serious or even taboo topics.

series.title: Check in Hanyang
series.description: Yongcheonru is the grandest guesthouse in Joseon. Their motto is that the customer is the king. Yeongcheonru has four new interns and they have their own reasons why they work there.

series.title: Yakout W Anber
series.description: The series revolves around the family of Moulay Ahmed, one of the most famous merchants in Casablanca, a father of six daughters, who dreams of having a son who will inherit his wealth and lineage. Moulay Ahmed's wife, Anber, discovers that the gender of her fetus is a girl again.

series.title: Twarza w twarz
series.description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

series.title: Dimension W
series.description: In the year 2072, the world's energy problems seem solved by a network of cross-dimensional electric-field inductors called "coils" that extract energy from a seemingly infinite source.

series.title: Generation W
series.description: Génération W, c'est une compétition où les équipes, flanquées de leurs supporters et de leur 'coach', peuvent se mesurer entre elles. On met chaque équipe au défi: on teste leur habilité à manier la manette, leur enthousiasme, leur débrouillardise et leurs connaissances. Mais c'est aussi des trucs pour mieux manoeuvrer dans l'univers des jeux, des cédéroms et de l'Internet; de nouvelles capsules anecdotiques où on découvre la petite histoire des jeux et des nouvelles technologies, une rubrique où on partage nos coups de coeur en matière de produits multimédia - mais où on se permet aussi de donner des coups de pied et de renvoyer les concepteurs à leur table à dessin; des reportages où on découvre des créateurs et des technologies à la sauce GW et un quizz où on jour le tout pour le tout pour mieux s'assurer la victoire.

series.title: W Magazine: #Keywords
series.description: In Elizabeth Hummer's fashion week series #KEYWORDS the essential elements of the Spring 2016 collections are broken down for Diane von Furstenberg, Narciso Rodriguez, Phillip Lim, Vera Wang, and Altuzarra. Get behind-the-scenes glimpses of the shows and input from attending editors, front row celebrities and the models who grace the runways.

series.title: My w Metropolii
series.description: News, documentary TV series examining what is a metropolis? Each show has unique guests from Gdansk like President Lech Walesa to actress Beata Pozniak Daniels.

series.title: Kamen Rider W
series.description: After an abundance of Gaia Memory related crimes in Fuuto, the self-proclaimed hard-boiled detective, Shotaro Hidari and the mysterious Phillip team up in order to protect the city from these Dopants - becoming Kamen Rider Double.

series.description: Lazy Sheep stumbled upon a few dreams that had come true .But in reality, it's not as good as his dream. He thought it was dangerous but was unharmed. But when he thought he was safe, he fell into the wolf's claws.

series.title: Agent X
series.description: Hidden from the view of the public - and even from the President - there is a top secret agent who is trained and ready to serve, deployed only at the careful discretion of the Vice President.

series.title: The X Files
series.description: Two F.B.I. Agents, Fox Mulder the believer and Dana Scully the skeptic, investigate the strange and unexplained, while hidden forces work to impede their efforts.

series.title: Al A'ela X
series.description: The events follow a forty-year-old widow whose teenage son disappears, so she begins a journey to search for him and discover his secrets and his private world

series.title: Z/X: Ignition
series.description: Five portals to different parallel worlds suddenly appear. Each must fight for survival with the key being the card device that can capture the invading Z/X creatures from the other worlds.

series.title: Dama y obrero
series.description: Julio Ulloa is a boy who has had very little luck in his life so far. He has done everything, like working on anything or the first thing he finds. For her part, Ignacia Villavicencio is an engineer who currently works at Constructora Omega and is about to marry Tomás Ahumada, an architect by profession who was her professor at university and is currently the owner of Constructora Omega.

series.title: Zip & Zap
series.description: Updated version, featuring computers, skateboards and contempo colloquialisms, of 'José Escobar''s classic comic book characters.

series.title: Alejo y Valentina
series.description: Alejo and Valentina are a couple that lives in a house in the middle of the forest. They have a lot of adventures, some of them are parodies of popular films and TV series, but are hilarious as well.

series.title: Sex, Love & Goop
series.description: Experts help couples to learn how to enhance their relationships through more pleasurable sex and deeper intimacy.

series.title: Tu y yo
series.description: A country musician man and a high-class architect woman fall in love.

series.title: Alegrijes y rebujos
series.description: A group of children discover the secret behind a haunted mansion.

series.title: Mujeres y hombres y viceversa
series.description: Program which aims to help participants to find love.

series.title: Y Pris
series.description: The series follows the tangled lives of a group of West-Walian gangsters. The drama centres on Lyn Edwards, who has responsibility thrust upon his shoulders when his father is taken ill. Lyn tries to juggle, a new girlfriend, family crises, a drug empire under threat, and the politics of the brotherhood - the ancient mafia organisation that runs everything in West Wales.

series.title: Sueños y caramelos
series.description: Sofia's grandfather is the head security guard at a huge department store, "El Gran Almacen". At night, while her grandfather guards the store, Sofia uses her imagination to turn the department store into a world of fantasy and dreams. She decides to tell her friends about this new world, and she and her friends have many adventures there. She meets a new boy, Juan, whom she believes is a poor orphan--but in fact he's the son of Mauricio, the department store's owner, and his biggest fear is that he'll lose her friendship forever if and when she discovers his true identity.

series.title: Donramon y Perchita
series.description: Online series about the adventures of DonRamon and Perchita

series.title: Pepa y Pepe
series.description: A sitcom about the everyday problems of a Spanish working class family.

series.title: Terror y feria
series.description: Collection of small, independent stories, with the premise that all of them are terror/bizarre related.

series.title: Magia y arte
series.description: Magia y Arte is a journey through dreams and magic with magician Miquel Roman. A journey with magic tricks, art and cardistry creating a new world of fantasy.

series.title: Amar y vivir
series.description: Joaquín, a village man, arrives to Bogotá unemployed and falls in love with Irene, a talented singer who works in the market place. Joaquín ends up working in the mafia, which threatens his relationship with Irene.

series.title: Hermanos y detectives
series.description: Franco Montero, an administrative detective, gets the unexpected obligation of the custody of his half-brother, Lorenzo Montero, who has an IQ of 200, and changes the way of life and work of the detective.

series.title: Tierras y profundidades
series.description: Documentary of ecological, geographical and human character of the Venezuelan lands and seas.

series.title: Olmos y Robles
series.description: In the quiet town of Ezcaray in Spain, police officers Olmos and Robles find themselves at ease beacuse there is no crime, until something horrible happe

series.title: Pobol y Cwm
series.description: A Welsh-language TV soap (the longest running BBC television soap) set in the small Welsh town of Cwmderi, in the heart of the South Wales valleys.

series.title: Trampas y caretas
series.description: Carmen Mackenna is a multimillionaire and obsessive mother who only wants to see her two children, now in their thirties, married and stable. For this, she will use all the tricks at her hand, which in this case took the form of an attractive woman, Mariana, to whom she entrusts the job of making them fall in love and taking the one she loves the most to the altar, in exchange for a generous monthly check.

series.title: Horacio y los Plasticines
series.description: Horacio is a 5-year-old boy with a great sense of wonder, passion, and curiosity. In each chapter his friends the plasticines help him with questions such as honesty, friendship, contamination and much more.

series.title: Morko y Mali
series.description: Morko and his sister Mali help the animals that inhabit the jungle around them. Meanwhile, they learn about mathematics and how to preserve the natural environment.

series.title: Monstruos y Piratas
series.description: Monsters and Pirates is an Italian animated series, about a pirate named Flinn and his crew, where piracy is taught at a school.

series.title: Sal y Pimienta
series.description: A Spanish talk show where the latest scoops of mostly Hispanic pop culture is reported on.

series.title: The Y
series.description: The Y is a SciFi psychological thriller about a woman with a split soul searching to reconnect before she becomes TheY.

series.title: Saber y ganar
series.description: Quiz show in which the contestants have to answer about general knowledge.

series.title: Conecta y Canta
series.description: A musical reality show where music meets child and youth talent from all over Mexico.

series.title: Naranja y media
series.description: Juan Guerrero has problems with his partner so they distance themselves, at that time he meets Ángeles 'Lali' Zabala and falls in love with her. Nothing is ever simple with Juan, so when he and his wife make up, he can't decide between her and Lali. From there, more characters complicate these entanglements: Juan's friends and relatives, former partners of his lovers, Juan's doppelganger named Santiago Gariboti and a kidnapper dressed in a Santa suit.

series.title: Zona Y
series.description: A young generation of students struggle between friends, family, college and dreams.

series.title: ¿Y ahora que?
series.description: 13-episode Documento-fiction series whose aim is to help boys and girls who are going through puberty to understand the physical, hormonal, social and emotional changes that take place at this stage of life.

series.title: Girlfriend, Girlfriend S1-S2
series.description: A honest young man is compelled to accept every girl who asks to be romantically involved with him.

series.title: Timeless
series.description: Millions of people around the world report experiences that seem inexplicable and incomprehensible to the mind: contact with spirit beings, near-death experiences, telepathy, materialization...what is behind these mysterious phenomena? In a unique format, scientists, experts and people who report on their incredible experiences now come together in a critical talk round. In TIMELESS, Johann Nepomuk Maier discusses with top-class guests such as Eben Alexander, Jana Haas, Walter von Lucadou, Paul Meek and Rupert Sheldrake at a scientific level every week. It is time to openly ask questions that are on so many people's minds. Because nothing seems to be as it is.

series.title: Carretera y manta
series.description: In a truck containing a portable TV studio, Jesús Cintora hits the road to find the most newsworthy stories.

series.title: Mudtown
series.description: Magistrate Claire Lewis Jones faces dilemmas as her daughter's friend faces charges and a criminal kingpin from her past resurfaces, entangling her family in a web of deceit that blurs the lines between justice and personal loyalties.

series.title: Marley y Mirko
series.description: An exclusive look into the life of one of the most beloved Argentinian TV hosts, their day-to-day life and what it is like to raise a child as a single parent while reflecting on their relationship as father and son.

series.title: Waldo y los Numerolocos
series.description: WALDO Y LOS NUMEROLOCOS, is a TV show for children in which preschoolers learn to think and resolve everyday problems through the development of mathematical skills while enjoying the adventures and stories of the actors and performers of the Infinity Circus.

series.title: Aprieta y gana
series.description: Battle of the sexes. Four female celebrities compete against four male celebrities in various games to win points, to win prizes, and to be declared the stronger sex.

series.title: Hermanos y detectives
series.description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

series.title: Z-Listers
series.description: Three friends navigate the social hierarchy of LA with hopes of moving up the social ladder. Turns out, making it into the A-List is a bit harder than they thought.

series.title: Z biegiem lat, z biegiem dni...
series.description: A story about the fate of two Krakow families, the action takes place in the years 1874-1914.

series.title: Lara com Z
series.description: The attempts of a middle-aged actress of bringing back her stardom.

series.title: A-Z Lifeshow
series.description: The "A - Z Lifeshow" takes a close look at everyday life. In an entertaining way, events, rituals, inventions, phenomenons and terms are examined. Amongst other Ernst Eiswürfel with his coolness tips appears in the show.

series.title: Z Fever
series.description: A massive outbreak occurs after discovering a chemical reaction that brings humans back to life.

series.title: High Water
series.description: When the flood wave approaches the capital of Lower Silesia, a decision is made to save the city from the destructive elements, the surrounding villages and fields should be sacrificed.

series.title: Moja Generacija Z
series.description: The "My Generation Z" series talks about teenagers who succeeded the famous "millennials" , the "Z" generation, or the graduates of Belgrade high school(born in 2000, in the year of the dragon in Chinese astrology). We follow the two-class heroes (from blue and red shift) in the first day of new school year in which they will make the important life desicions.Dramatic complications, enriched with humor and music, talk about dilemmas and problems, as well as the joys in the life of young people in Serbia, their parents and professors.

series.title: Z Cars
series.description: A gritty drama which follows the work of the police force in the fictional town of Newtown in the North of England.

series.title: Z-Mind [English]
series.description: In the year 1976, an alien species called the Orgapiens has invaded the Earth and three sisters, Ayame, Renge and Sumire have to pilot the Z-Mind to stop it.

series.title: Kava z Kardamonom
series.description: Lviv, at the dawn of the nineteenth century. Young Anna is living a simple life, helping her uncle in the bakery, while her brother is in the seminary. Yet, Anna dreams of something much grander: true, mutual love. Her family has a different idea for her. She is supposed to marry the wealthy tradesman Marykan - and while he is in love with her, she cannot muster the same feelings for him. Then everything changes, when Count Adam Rodzinsky arrives to visit his sick uncle Witold. First, Anna is afraid of the older Adam. But then, she develops feelings for him, especially when they start to cross paths more and more frequently. Turns out, Adam was once married to a distant relative of Anna's, but the relationship ended in tragedy. Anna reminds him of his former beloved. Yet as their love blossoms, it remains forbidden.

series.title: Object Z
series.description: A mysterious object is sighted heading towards Earth and causes panic. But what is the nature & origin of the object, and how can it be stopped?

series.title: Z-Squad [English]
series.description: Z-Squad chronicles the adventures of schoolgirls-turned-superheroes Chaney, Haemi, and Jeanie and their newfound, cuddly alien counterparts (Zoots) as they search for 144 enchanted crystals and save Earth and Z-Nation from a cast of bumbling baddies.

series.title: Command Z
series.description: A scientist tasks his employees with a "historic" mission to travel back in time to revise history and save the world.

series.title: Z-Mind
series.description: In the year 1976, an alien species called the Orgapiens has invaded the Earth and three sisters, Ayame, Renge and Sumire have to pilot the Z-Mind to stop it.

series.title: Generation Z
series.description: A web series following 5 diverse teens whose lives begin to intersect when they end up in a therapy/support group. We see their journeys in the program, the situations that landed them there, and their daily lives as teens in Generation Z.

series.title: The Z
series.description: A mocumentary set at a well known gym/community center in the heart of Hollywood and its day-to-day dealings with ridiculous employees, sassy children, and uppity parents.

series.title: Z-Squad
series.description: Z-Squad chronicles the adventures of schoolgirls-turned-superheroes Chaney, Haemi, and Jeanie and their newfound, cuddly alien counterparts (Zoots) as they search for 144 enchanted crystals and save Earth and Z-Nation from a cast of bumbling baddies.

series.title: Z Rock
series.description: "ZO2," which centers on a real-life heavy metal band that makes a living by day as performers at kiddie birthday parties. Other scripts in the hopper include a family drama set in the world of porn, a workplace comedy based at a counter terrorism agency and an hour long entry about addicts.

series.title: Fc Z
series.description: 15 nerds who have never played football in their life are trained by professional player Glenn Hysén to play a match against Djurgården.

series.title: Project Z
series.description: 5 schoolchildren must solve puzzles and avoid rampaging zombies in order to escape their school in this post apocalyptic adventure game show.

series.title: Cetníci z Luhacovic
series.description: Cetníci z Luhacovic

series.title: Dragon Ball Z Abridged
series.description: Dragon Ball Z Abridged is a direct parody with most characters and plot lines remaining relatively unchanged.

series.title: Zorro: Generation Z - The Animated Series
series.description: In 2015, teenager Diego Dela Vega, the five times great-grandson of the first Zorro, in turn wears the mask, with a black suit, weapons, and signs the "Z" to establish justice in the metropolis of Pueblo Grande, California.

series.title: Saving Little Z
series.description: Deputy Scott is forced by the Evil Corp to capture young zombies for testing, but he gets more than he bargains for when he marries Lisa, the mother of a tween zombie girl.

series.title: Control Z [English] S3
series.description: When a hacker begins releasing students' secrets to the entire high school, the socially isolated but observant Sofía works to uncover his/her identity.

series.title: The Detective Is Already Dead [English] S1-S2
series.description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

series.title: Keishichô 0 gakari: Seikatsu anzen ka nandemo sôdanshitsu
The Big 4-0
series.description: Each episode, real people mark a major milestone, their 40th birthday, in amazing ways. Derrick, a former NFL player, sets out to prove he can still compete against the best. Lisa, a model-turned-mom, throws an extravagant Beverly Hills bash full of surprises and family drama, but will she finally embrace her age? Brian, a former thrill seeker who is now wheelchair-bound, aspires to skydive and ride a horse again. Rita, an Italian-American woman whose family never fit in growing up in rural Utah, heads to Italy to trace her roots. Tonya, in the midst of a divorce, had to cancel her plans for a Jamaican birthday trip. Can her friends pull together and make her wishes come true? DeeAnn lost her fiancé seven years ago, but she is now moving on. Will an 18th-century-themed masquerade ball and finding Prince Charming do the trick?

series.title: Zero: Dragon Blood
series.description: In DRAGON BLOOD, Rei Suzumura continues to hunt Horrors in a certain city. One day, he meets a young woman in love with photography, Alice Hiromi. After witnessing Makai Knight ZERO in action, she develops an interest in Rei. Meanwhile, a carriage crosses a far away bridge. The carriage contains a coffin in which a man lies. That man is none other than the Dragon Knight, who used the power of Dragons to hunt Horrors.

series.title: Mars - zero no kakumei -
series.description: Mishima Zero is a 19-year-old mysterious transfer student who gathers a bunch of "failed" high school students to "destroy the world with him". Zero has a unique appearance and charismatic charm that allows him to penetrate people's hearts and manipulate people with his words. Led by Zero, the high school students form a group called "Mars" to breakdown and rebuild the society created by adults.

series.title: Zero Method
series.description: Ethan 'Zero' Locke risks everything in a desperate attempt to break the prime rule of time travel that separates him from his old life; going to the future is permanent, but travel to the past is only temporary.

series.title: The Eternal Zero
series.description: The story of Saeki Kentaro, who continues to fail the National Bar Examinations and lose sight of the goal of his life, and his old sister Keiko, who is a freelance writer looking up their grandfather Miyabe who died in the Pacific War as a Kamikaze pilot. Miyabe had an astute ability as a pilot of fighter planes, but he was extraordinarily afraid of death. His two grandchildren started wondering why he applied for the Kamikaze corps. Revealing Miyabe's unexpected title of "genius yet coward", they unveil a surprising fact which has been sealed for over 60 years.

series.title: Zero Contact
series.description: Zero Contact

series.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
series.description: After decades of war, the hero Dias receives an abandoned territory and begins building a kingdom there.
